text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to live up to everyone's

expectations...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't win. At the end of the day,
that's all
that matters.
choice_data_list: Even so, you ran really well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I could hear people sighing with
disappointment.
I... I...

...Oguri Cap stands motionless, proving
just how
frustrating this loss is to her.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good job out there, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I won this time. So... do you
want to
end our rivalry here?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: N-no...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then you've got to keep moving
forward. I'll be
waiting for you a little
further down the line.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I plan to win next time too though—so
you'd best
come prepared!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not gonna lose again.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I need to get stronger and prove that I
can beat
Creek next time!

Driven by Super Creek's words, Oguri
Cap is
already looking toward the
future.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've gotta get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Creek said she'd be waiting for me
further down
the line. She must have
been talking about next
year's Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That means I have to qualify. And next time, I'm gonna beat her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to disappoint anyone
anymore!

Oguri Cap is more than competent
enough as she
is. All she needs to do
now is keep gaining
experience in G1
races.

There, she'll be able to polish her skills
by facing
off against many powerful
competitors. Such
experiences will surely
expedite her growth.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's enter lots of races!

text_block_list.text:
She's all fired up! But just as we're about
to
discuss which race to take on next, a
familiar face
interrupts us.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sorry to butt in!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I was watchin' the whole time! Ya did
great,
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I could tell you were really puttin' your
all into it.
Seriously, great job.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Tama—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: H-hey, you okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm fine. I just feel a little
weak...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I've been wanting to
see you.
The wave of relief must've been
a little much for
me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you cut that out!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
D'ya think I'm your momma or somethin'?
'Cause
I'm pretty sure I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm an Umamusume! Have ya forgotten that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Of course not. What else would
you be?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The heck kind of answer is that? Don'tcha know what that means?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What I'm tryin' to say is dat I'm your rival
as well!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now ya get it! So it's decided! We gotta
go
head-to-head!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I was plannin' on aimin' for the
Dream
Trophy next year.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh really?

The Dream Trophy League—a
higher-level league
where Umamusume
who have proven themselves
in the
Twinkle Series compete.

Having debuted a little earlier than
Oguri Cap,
aiming for the Dream Trophy
League should be
the natural next step
for Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But after seein' your battle with Creek, I
made up
my mind to stay back for a year
and prove I can
beat ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's determine once and for all who's
the
best—me, you, or Creek!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got that, Oguri? I'm your opponent next
time!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine. All right, let's get to work on
our next
plan.

Oguri Cap's battle with Super Creek may
be over,
but now she has another
powerful rival who wants
to take her on.

She seems to have a lot to mull over. It's
time for
the two of us to get to work.
